# States (`State`)

What a device reports. The JSON is what API v1 returns under `state`.

`Driver::read_state(device)` returns what the device says **now**, in the variant for its class. A value the device does not report is `None` (or the variant's "unknown" form), never a guess and never the last value you sent: the hub confirms commands from this, so a state made up from what was sent would confirm commands that did nothing. Text the device supplies goes through `net::device_text` first.

`State` is `#[non_exhaustive]`. The JSON is what API v1 returns under `state`: an object with the variant in `kind`.

| State | Reported by class | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`light`](#light) | `light` | `{"kind":"light","on":true,"bri":40,"hue":210,"color":true}` |
| [`bridge`](#bridge) | `bridge` | `{"kind":"bridge","reachable":true}` |
| [`plug`](#plug) | `plug` | `{"kind":"plug","on":false}` |
| [`aircon`](#aircon) | `aircon` | `{"kind":"aircon","on":true,"mode":"cool","target":22,"fan":"auto","indoor":24,"outdoor":null}` |
| [`speaker`](#speaker) | `speaker` | `{"kind":"speaker","vol":25,"mute":false,"playing":true,"source":"tv","night":false}` |
| [`tv`](#tv) | `tv` | `{"kind":"tv","on":true,"input":"HDMI 1"}` |
| [`feeder`](#feeder) | `feeder` | `{"kind":"feeder","last":"2026-01-01 08:00","portions":12}` |
| [`litter`](#litter) | `litter` | `{"kind":"litter","last":null,"busy":false,"cycles":7}` |
| [`printer`](#printer) | `printer` | `{"kind":"printer","state":"printing","nozzle":210.5,"bed":60.0,"layer":12,"layers":240,"pct":5.0}` |
| [`vm`](#vm) | `vm` | `{"kind":"vm","state":"running","uptime_s":3600}` |
| [`host`](#host) | `host` | `{"kind":"host","up":true,"uptime_s":86400}` |
| [`router`](#router) | `router` | `{"kind":"router","wireguard_up":true,"uptime_s":1200}` |
| [`camera`](#camera) | `camera` | `{"kind":"camera","streaming":true}` |
| [`service`](#service) | `service` | `{"kind":"service","reachable":true}` |
| [`telemetry`](#telemetry) | `telemetry` | `{"kind":"telemetry","data":{"cpu_temp":48.5,"memory":0.42}}` |
| [`custom`](#custom) | `other` | `{"kind":"custom","fields":{"calibrated":true,"position":40}}` |

## light

`State::Light`. `color` is false in white or scene mode, where `hue` is only a tint.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on` | `bool` | Whether it is on. |
| `bri` | `u8` | Brightness in percent. |
| `hue` | `u16` | Colour as a hue angle in degrees. |
| `color` | `bool` | Whether the light is showing a colour, so `hue` can confirm a colour change. |

```json
{
  "kind": "light",
  "on": true,
  "bri": 40,
  "hue": 210,
  "color": true
}
```

Confirms: `light_power`, `light_brightness`, `light_hue`, `light_set`

## aircon

`State::Aircon`. An air conditioner. Each of the others is absent when the unit gives no usable value for it.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on` | `bool` | Whether it is on. |
| `mode` | `Option<String>` | The mode it is in. |
| `target` | `Option<i16>` | The target temperature, in degrees Celsius. |
| `fan` | `Option<String>` | The fan speed. |
| `indoor` | `Option<i16>` | The temperature indoors, in degrees Celsius. |
| `outdoor` | `Option<i16>` | The temperature outdoors, in degrees Celsius. |

```json
{
  "kind": "aircon",
  "on": true,
  "mode": "cool",
  "target": 22,
  "fan": "auto",
  "indoor": 24,
  "outdoor": null
}
```

Confirms: `aircon_power`, `aircon_mode`, `aircon_temp`, `aircon_fan`

## speaker

`State::Speaker`. A speaker. `night` is absent when the speaker has no night mode or would not say.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vol` | `u8` | Volume from 0 to 100. |
| `mute` | `bool` | Whether it is muted. |
| `playing` | `bool` | Whether it is playing. |
| `source` | `String` | What it is playing from. |
| `night` | `Option<bool>` | Whether night mode is on. |

```json
{
  "kind": "speaker",
  "vol": 25,
  "mute": false,
  "playing": true,
  "source": "tv",
  "night": false
}
```

Confirms: `volume`, `volume_cap`, `mute`, `night_mode`, `play`, `pause`

## printer

`State::Printer`. A 3D printer.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `String` | What it is doing: "printing", "paused", "stopped", and so on. |
| `nozzle` | `f64` | Nozzle temperature, in degrees Celsius. |
| `bed` | `f64` | Bed temperature, in degrees Celsius. |
| `layer` | `u32` | The layer it is on. |
| `layers` | `u32` | How many layers the print has. |
| `pct` | `f64` | How far the print is, in percent. |

```json
{
  "kind": "printer",
  "state": "printing",
  "nozzle": 210.5,
  "bed": 60.0,
  "layer": 12,
  "layers": 240,
  "pct": 5.0
}
```

Confirms: `print_start`, `print_pause`, `print_resume`, `print_emergency_stop`

## custom

`State::Custom`. For a class the hub has no shape for. Custom actions confirm against it.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fields` | `BTreeMap<String, Scalar>` | The fields the device reports, by name. |

```json
{
  "kind": "custom",
  "fields": {
    "calibrated": true,
    "position": 40
  }
}
```

Confirms: `custom`
